episodes.synopsis: Ash and Pikachu have arrived in the Kalos region, and they waste no time building excitement and adventure to a fever pitch!
episodes.title: Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!

episodes.synopsis: After helping an ailing Pokémon, Ash puts everything he's got on the line, while an entire city bears witness!
episodes.title: Lumiose City Pursuit!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is eager to catch some Kalos Pokémon, and he's definitely not alone!
episodes.title: A Battle of Aerial Mobility!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their Kalos region journey, exciting new Pokémon friendships are the order of the day!
episodes.title: A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is vying for his first Kalos Gym badge, but has our hero gotten more than he bargained for?
episodes.title: A Blustery Santalune Gym Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Never one to give up, Ash sets his sights on a rematch with Gym Leader Viola in order to win his first Kalos region Gym badge!
episodes.title: Battling on Thin Ice!

episodes.synopsis: There's an opportunity to be part of an exciting Rhyhorn race, and Ash can't wait to give it a try!
episodes.title: Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race!

episodes.synopsis: Seeing a superstar Pokémon groomer in their tour guide, our heroes are later shocked to meet him and his assistant in person!
episodes.title: Grooming Furfrou!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes arrive back in Lumiose City, Clemont and Bonnie reveal a secret that has everyone else in shock!
episodes.title: Clemont's Got a Secret!

episodes.synopsis: During a visit with Professor Sycamore while in Lumiose City, our heroes encounter a surprising foe of mega-mega proportions!
episodes.title: Mega-Mega Meowth Madness!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes traverse a forest on their way to Cyllage City, some new Pokémon give them quite a challenge, and some old foes do, too!
episodes.title: The Bamboozling Forest!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their journey to Cyllage City and Ash's next Gym battle, they must confront a most unsavory character in a most unsavory line of work!
episodes.title: To Catch a Pokémon Smuggler!

episodes.synopsis: What starts out as a typical battle challenge between two Trainers in the middle of the forest leads to a life-changing experience for one young boy!
episodes.title: Kindergarten Chaos!

episodes.synopsis: A powerful rainstorm brings our heroes to a scary mansion seeking shelter, but with an unexpected outcome!
episodes.title: Seeking Shelter from the Storm!

episodes.synopsis: A misunderstanding while camping out for the night turns out to be the perfect opportunity for some serious Pokémon-and-Trainer bonding!
episodes.title: An Appetite for Battle!

episodes.synopsis: A visit to the local Pokémon Center results in a mix-up that has our heroes scrambling to undo it!
episodes.title: A Jolting Switcheroo!

episodes.synopsis: Continuing to Cyllage City, our heroes encounter a powerful young ninja and his equally powerful Frogadier, and both have much to share!
episodes.title: A Rush of Ninja Wisdom!

episodes.synopsis: Arriving in Camphrier Town, our heroes find themselves in the middle of a dilemma of epic proportions!
episodes.title: Awakening the Sleeping Giant!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket may still be after Pikachu, but for now, everyone's got another powerful Pokémon on their minds!
episodes.title: A Conspiracy to Conquer!

episodes.synopsis: A visit to an incredible Kalos region battling institution presents our heroes with lasting memories, and a surprising revelation!
episodes.title: Breaking Titles at the Chateau!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are exploring the world of Pokévision, and it's chock-full of epic productions and cinematic surprises!
episodes.title: A Pokévision of Things to Come!

episodes.synopsis: A visit by our heroes to an amazing aquarium turns out to reveal the stuff of legends!
episodes.title: Going for the Gold!

episodes.synopsis: After running into an old friend, our heroes are about to witness a major discovery they'll never forget!
episodes.title: Coming Back into the Cold!

episodes.synopsis: The time for Ash's Gym battle with Grant at the Cyllage City Gym is finally here, and it's an uphill climb!
episodes.title: Climbing the Walls!

episodes.synopsis: A sweet treat has Serena competing head-to-head in a battle of skills, wits, and hearts!
episodes.title: A Battle by Any Other Name!

episodes.synopsis: A new hairstyle for Bonnie leads our heroes to new friends in need!
episodes.title: To Find a Fairy Flower!

episodes.synopsis: A chance encounter with the Champion gives our heroes a deeper look into the mysteries of Evolution!
episodes.title: The Bonds of Evolution!

episodes.synopsis: A case of mistaken identity is part of a sinister plot to catch Pikachu once and for all!
episodes.title: Heroes - Friends and Faux Alike!

episodes.synopsis: A chance meeting with Korrina and her partner Lucario presents our heroes with more surprises then they could've imagined!
episodes.title: Mega Revelations!

episodes.synopsis: The search for Lucarionite is on, and Korrina faces challenges she never dreamed of!
episodes.title: The Cave of Trials!

episodes.synopsis: Korrina, Lucario, and our heroes discover there is much more to Mega Evolution than they ever imagined!
episodes.title: The Aura Storm!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Pomace Mountain, Korrina, Lucario, and our heroes witness the next step in the Mega Evolution saga!
episodes.title: Calling from Beyond the Aura!

episodes.synopsis: Korrina and Lucario are on Pomace Mountain with our heroes, where they learn more about Mega Evolution in a most unexpected way!
episodes.title: The Bonds of Mega Evolution!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Shalour City, our heroes come across an amazing Pokémon with a powerful and unique way of battling!
episodes.title: The Forest Champion!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their journey to Shalour City, a different kind of battle piques their interest!
episodes.title: Battles in the Sky!

episodes.synopsis: While exploring a well-known cave on their way to Shalour City, our heroes see themselves in unexpectedly different ways!
episodes.title: The Cave of Mirrors!

episodes.synopsis: Some family squabbling gives rise to some fabulous teamwork!
episodes.title: Forging Forest Friendships!

episodes.synopsis: It's day one of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon summer camp, and the excitement and adventures are just getting under way!
episodes.title: Summer of Discovery!

episodes.synopsis: It's day three of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Summer Camp, and Pokévision is on everyone's minds!
episodes.title: Day Three Blockbusters!

episodes.synopsis: On day five of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon summer camp, Pokémon Orienteering leads our heroes to a mysterious discovery!
episodes.title: Foggy Pokémon Orienteering!

episodes.synopsis: It's the final day of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon summer camp, and entry into the hall of fame is right around the corner for the winning team!
episodes.title: Battling Into the Hall of Fame!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have finally arrived in Shalour City, and Ash's Gym battle against Korrina is imminent!
episodes.title: Origins of Mega Evolution!

episodes.synopsis: The long-awaited Gym battle between Ash and Korrina is getting under way, and it promises to be white-hot!
episodes.title: Showdown at the Shalour Gym!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes make their way to Coumarine City and Ash's next Gym battle, they come across two brothers with a lesson to learn, and to share!
episodes.title: Splitting Heirs!

episodes.synopsis: A visit to a nearby Pokémon Center introduces our heroes to a Wigglytuff with an unusual way of doing things!
episodes.title: The Clumsy Crier Quiets the Chaos!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet up with Shauna, their friend from summer camp, who takes them to see their first Pokémon Showcase!
episodes.title: Dreaming a Performer's Dream!

episodes.synopsis: Clemont revisits his school days and meets up with a couple of old friends, both people and Pokémon!
episodes.title: A Campus Reunion!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue toward the Coumarine City Gym, Bonnie makes some new friends, and they're a force to be reckoned with!
episodes.title: Bonnie for the Defense!

episodes.synopsis: After a squabble between friends, a chance meeting gives our heroes a chance for some unexpected teamwork!
episodes.title: Pathways to Performance Partnering!

episodes.synopsis: Before Ash's Cyllage City Gym battle, a visit to the Muraille Coast set our heroes on an aquatic adventure filled with undersea Pokémon!
episodes.title: An Undersea Place to Call Home!

episodes.synopsis: After Ash makes a mistake, his Hawlucha finds itself in the performance of a lifetime!
episodes.title: When Light and Dark Collide!

episodes.synopsis: After running into a friend, our heroes embark upon an adventure filled with stealth and surprise!
episodes.title: A Stealthy Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: A visit to a Skiddo ranch provides our heroes with some unexpected challenges!
episodes.title: A Race for Home!

episodes.synopsis: The entire world is in danger, and an unlikely group of long time foes must join forces to save it!
episodes.title: Facing the Grand Design!

episodes.synopsis: A chance encounter with a Pokémon in need leads our heroes into an unexpected adventure!
episodes.title: A Slippery Encounter!

episodes.synopsis: The newest member of our heroes' Pokémon family is in trouble, but their smallest member steps in to help!
episodes.title: One for the Goomy!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have arrived in Coumarine City, and they are immediately confronted by a crisis with bone-chilling consequences!
episodes.title: Thawing an Icy Panic!

episodes.synopsis: The time for Ash's Coumarine City Gym battle is here, and with it the chance to learn and grow!
episodes.title: The Green, Green Grass Types of Home!

episodes.synopsis: A Coumarine City tradition is in jeopardy, and our heroes are faced with averting a major crisis!
episodes.title: Under the Pledging Tree!

episodes.synopsis: It's Serena's Pokémon Showcase debut, surrounded by friends and rivals, old and new!
episodes.title: A Showcase Debut!

episodes.synopsis: There's a bully in the Lumiose Badlands, and many helpless Pokémon are depending on our heroes for their freedom!
episodes.title: An Oasis of Hope!

episodes.synopsis: When the Kalos Power Plant is held under siege, the safety of Lumiose City and many Pokémon hangs in the balance!
episodes.title: The Future Is Now, Thanks to Determination!

episodes.synopsis: A conflict of heartfelt emotions threatens the future of a longstanding partnership!
episodes.title: A Fork in the Road! A Parting of the Ways!

episodes.synopsis: A chance meeting with a mystery Pokémon performer provides Serena and her Pokémon with some priceless advice and support!
episodes.title: Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!

episodes.synopsis: A surprise reunion with an old friend give Ash the perfect opportunity for training - and even more surprises!
episodes.title: Good Friends, Great Training!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is finally in Lumiose City for his Gym battle with Clemont, but a major crisis threatens the proceedings!
episodes.title: Confronting the Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: The long-awaited Gym battle between Ash and Gym Leader Clemont is off and running, and lots of intense training is being put to the test!
episodes.title: The Moment of Lumiose Truth!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes visit Professor Sycamore on their way out of Lumiose City, they're in for a surprise of mega proportions!
episodes.title: Garchomp's Mega Bond!

episodes.synopsis: With Goodra's beloved wetlands in imminent danger, our heroes are faced with a must-win situation for the sake of the many Pokémon who live there!
episodes.title: Defending the Homeland!

episodes.synopsis: With Goodra's beloved wetlands in imminent danger, our heroes are faced with a must-win situation for the sake of the many Pokémon who live there!
episodes.title: Beyond the Rainbow!

episodes.synopsis: The daily fortune in Serena's guidebook predicts a bad day for our heroes, and that prediction turns out to be accurate!
episodes.title: So You're Having a Bad Day!

episodes.synopsis: A rainy night and an old mansion combine to give our heroes an evening to remember, or not!
episodes.title: Scary Hospitality!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have arrived in Laverre City, and the Gym Leader there has a wardrobe of surprises in store!
episodes.title: A Fashionable Battle!

episodes.synopsis: It is time for Ash's battle with Valerie at the Laverre Gym, and it appears thinking on his feet could be our hero's key to victory!
episodes.title: Fairy-Type Trickery!

episodes.synopsis: After Ash's fierce battle with Valerie at the Laverre Gym, young Sawyer has a lot of questions!
episodes.title: Rivals: Today and Tomorrow!

episodes.synopsis: A chance discovery on their way to Anistar City gives our heroes a challenging teaching moment!
episodes.title: A Not-So-Flying-Start!

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected race provides our heroes with an opportunity to give their newest member a chance to spread its wings!
episodes.title: A Relay in the Sky!

episodes.synopsis: A masterpiece is in the making, and our heroes can't wait to be involved!
episodes.title: Lights! Camera! Pika!

episodes.synopsis: A tour of the Poké Ball Factory provides our heroes with much more than just Poké Balls!
episodes.title: A Frenzied Factory Fiasco!

episodes.synopsis: Serena's next Pokémon Showcase appearance is taking place in Dendemille Town, and she's faced with some stiff competition!
episodes.title: Performing with Fiery Charm!

episodes.synopsis: A visit to a peculiar hotel gives our heroes the chance to right a wrong from long ago!
episodes.title: Rotom's Wish!

episodes.synopsis: During a visit to a popular festival, our heroes fall victim to several cases of mistaken identity!
episodes.title: A Festival Trade! A Festival Farewell?

episodes.synopsis: A trip over a snow-covered mountain gives our heroes the chance to truly help those in need!
episodes.title: Over the Mountain of Snow!

episodes.synopsis: When the power goes out at a Pokémon Center, our heroes and their Pokémon come to the rescue!
episodes.title: Adventures in Running Errands!

episodes.synopsis: A crisis in confidence leads to renewed strength and determination!
episodes.title: Mending a Broken Spirit!

episodes.synopsis: A chance reunion with an old friend gives our heroes an experience of legendary proportions!
episodes.title: A Legendary Photo Op!

episodes.synopsis: A Pokémon in need provides a heartfelt lesson in caring, and letting go.
episodes.title: The Tiny Caretaker!

episodes.synopsis: An emergency situation offers the perfect opportunity to recall a heartwarming story of times past!
episodes.title: A Trip Down Memory Train!

episodes.synopsis: A beautiful meadow provides our heroes with the perfect spot to take a break and witness a surprising performance!
episodes.title: A Frolicking Find in the Flowers!

episodes.synopsis: A friendly Tag Battle provides Eevee and Serena with some confidence and inspiration!
episodes.title: Tag Team Battle Inspiration!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Anistar City Pokémon Showcase, and a second Princess Key hangs in the balance for Serena!
episodes.title: A Performance Pop Quiz!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes look to Ash's next battle at the Anistar City Gym, they discover things about its Gym Leader they never could have imagined!
episodes.title: Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!

episodes.synopsis: The time for Ash's Anistar City Gym battle has arrived, but in this case, time has some unexpected meanings!
episodes.title: All Eyes on the Future!
